name: curriculum-list
title: Curriculum list
description: A course outline: modules that fold open to lessons with type, length and state, so learners see what is done, current, locked or free to preview.
docs: modules is { id, title, lessons }[] and each lesson { id, title, type (video, reading or quiz), minutes?, state?, href?, reason? }. A module header says how far the learner is (3 of 5 lessons, counted from lessons whose state is completed) and how long the module takes in all, with a thin bar that shows it. current is the id of the lesson the learner is on: its row says Current in words, is marked aria-current (page when it is a link, true when it is a button) and, when you leave expanded to the list, its module starts open. state is completed, locked, preview or available (the default, which says nothing): a locked lesson is not a link or a button, takes no tab stop and says why through reason; a preview lesson is marked Preview. A lesson with an href is a link and onSelect(lesson, module, event) runs on it, so a client-side router can call event.preventDefault(); without an href but with onSelect it is a button. expanded (the ids of the open modules) with onExpandedChange controls the folds; defaultExpanded only sets where they start. Several modules can be open at once. The open and close animation is height-based and switches off under reduced motion. labels carries every word, with {done}, {total} and {count} filled in.
